article_framing_rejections.headline: Okeechobee High School to open new $107 million building for 2026 school year

lead_independence.headline: Okeechobee High School to open new $107 million building for 2026 school year
lead_independence.lead: Superintendent Dylan Tedders gave a tour of the new facility Thursday, highlighting what makes it a major upgrade from the previous high school, which was built in the 1960s. The new building features 85 classrooms and will be the first time all of Okeechobee's high school students can learn from the same campus. Previously, freshmen attended a separate campus. The gym is big enough to seat 1,900 people and the auditorium is big enough to seat a full class at 500 seats.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Boca Raton to invest over $1 million in police officers, coordinator to address homelessness

lead_independence.headline: Boca Raton to invest over $1 million in police officers, coordinator to address homelessness
lead_independence.lead: The City of Boca Raton is expanding law enforcement and outreach efforts to address homelessness, approving plans to hire four new police officers and a Community Resource Coordinator. During a Monday workshop, city leaders directed City Manager Mark Sohaney to move forward with the hires and create a Quality of Life Working Group. Mayor Andy Thomson said the investment is designed to strengthen both public safety and services for people experiencing homelessness.
